newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed flat at 43.7495/7500 to the dollar in interbank trading on Wednesday amid a continuing shortfall of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted weaker and in a wide range at 43.7495/7600 per dollar in early trade but recovered to close flat. Thursday is a public holiday.
Interbank call money rates closed unchanged at 6.5 percent to 7.5 percent, dealers said.
